item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 20/Aug/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad trough of low pressure will continue to bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening, the weather will be fine and very hot over southern China early next week. An upper-air disturbance is expected to bring unsettled weather to the region in the middle and latter parts of next week.

Date/Month: 21/08 (Sunday)
Wind: South to southeast force 3 to 4, force 5 offshore at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers and isolated thunderstorms. Hot with sunny periods in the afternoon.
Temp range: 27 - 32 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
